headline: Structure-aware models for peptide affinity and protein binding-site prediction
label: Structure Aware Binding Prediction
summary: Benchmarks now test affinity models under peptide and target shifts, while AlphaFold-derived structure feeds co-folding scoring and binding-site retrieval.
synthesis: The common thread is conditioning binding and interaction predictions on structural or structure-derived representations, with evaluation moving toward held-out generalization. OmniScore encodes proteins, nucleic acids and small molecules with an equivariant geometry-aware encoder for complex quality assessment and interaction scoring. FoldKit exposes AlphaFold 3 co-folding confidence metrics, including ipTM, ipAE and ipSAE, through programmatic access. KAT-Net pairs ESM-2 embeddings with AlphaFold2 structural graphs for lysine acylation site prediction. PocketScope retrieves binding sites across the AlphaFold human proteome from frozen ESM-C residue embeddings without pooling. The peptide-protein benchmark evaluates affinity models across peptide-similarity, within-target and leave-target-out splits. Other items are heterogeneous, including sequence-only TabPFN antimicrobial peptide profiling, sparse autoencoder features in ESM-2 mutation prediction, and generative peptide design. What is new is the use of residue- and interface-level structural metrics together with generalization-focused splits.
